records.text: The Falkirk Center was designed to combine Charlie Kirk’s youth appeal with evangelical ministry and recruitment to Liberty University.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The aim was to harness the energy of Charlie's brand with the youth and to turn that into ministry for evangelicals and to inspire young people to go to Liberty University to sign up and to go to Liberty University because Jerry Falwell Jr.

verification.notes: Liberty’s own description supports that the center joined Kirk’s youth-oriented conservative activism with evangelical faith, student ambassadors, and Liberty-based outreach. “Recruitment to Liberty” is a reasonable inference from its campus role, but is less explicit than the rest.
